messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: hyperlink actions
parts:
Hi,

  How might I handle a click on a value in a table cell? 

  I want to initiate UI changes including adding a tab, etc.

  Should I route the value to an input using javascript, or is there a better way?

  If I force the value of a tabset can I subsequently add the tab?

-Alex

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: hyperlink actions
parts:
Today, you would have to handle the click on a table cell manually using jQuery. $(document).on('click', 'table#foo td', function(e) { ... }) or whatever.

To route the value to the server, yes, send it using JavaScript (the quick and dirty way being Shiny.shinyapp.sendInput({name: value}), but we should have better ways to do this soon). I recommend having your value be an object that includes a nonce (could just be monotonically increasing number) and the data i.e. table cell that was clicked, if you care about responding to multiple clicks on the same cell. (If this is just driving selection then no need for the nonce)

As for adding a tab to the tabset, I'm not sure how this works in Bootstrap. If it's possible in JS then you can use session$sendInputMessage.
